Installation Guide

Follow these steps to set up the Famous Gate Management System on your local development environment or production server.

Prerequisites

Node.js

v18.x or higher

Python

3.10 or higher

PostgreSQL

v14 or higher

Git

Latest version

Step-by-Step Setup

1. Clone the Repository

git clone https://github.com/your-repo/famous-gate.git
cd famous-gate

2. Backend Configuration

Install dependencies and set up environment variables.

cd backend
npm install
cp .env.example .env

Ensure you update the .env file with your database credentials and JWT secret.

3. Frontend Setup

cd ../frontend
npm install
npm run dev

4. Python Services

cd ../python-services
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate # On Windows: venv\\Scripts\\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py

Verification

Once all services are running, you can verify the installation by visiting:

  • • Frontend: http://localhost:3001
  • • Backend API: http://localhost:5000/api/health
  • • Python Services: http://localhost:5001/health
